title: sv-llm.capability-id/v0.1
description: Shared controlled vocabulary of Sandbox capability identifiers. Each identifier has exactly one canonical meaning, given by its description below. Adding or redefining an identifier requires a versioned change to this document; entity repositories MUST NOT create canonical meanings locally. sandbox-work, entity-capability, CAPABILITY_ASSIGNMENT evidence and contribution all reference this vocabulary. A capability identifier never confers governance or any other authority.

oneOf.description: Analyze supplied information to derive bounded conclusions, implications, or solution steps.

Combine multiple attributable inputs into a derived work product while preserving source lineage, disagreement, refusal, and uncertainty. An entity declaring synthesis may contribute a synthesis within its bounded assignment; this does not transfer or replace the Sandbox runtime responsibility to synthesize participating contributions into expected_output_or_handoff.
Inspect supplied source code or code artifacts to identify structure, behavior, defects, constraints, or implications.
Produce candidate source code or code artifacts within the manifested and permitted work bounds.
Inspect supplied documents or document content to extract, compare, classify, or derive bounded findings.
Compare declared interfaces, schemas, invariants, or contracts across multiple authorized repository views without treating repository reachability as evidence.
Challenge a candidate claim, design, artifact, or conclusion by searching for contradictions, unsupported assumptions, failure modes, or counterexamples.
Produce a bounded proposed correction to an identified defect or incompatibility without directly authorizing or executing the consequential transition.
Derive a non-authoritative projected disposition from supplied disposition-complete evidence while preserving that the result is inference rather than governance.

not_prohibited.description: Authority-like identifiers cannot enter the vocabulary: the exact identifier governance, and any identifier matching (^|_)authority$.

proposed_identifier.description: Validates an identifier proposed for a future version of this vocabulary: syntax and the authority guard only.
